verdict.rationale: The pricing page documents monthly search quotas, such as the Free plan's 250 searches per month. It also offers a self-serve Automatic Early Renewal once searches run out, and docs clarify that cached searches don't count toward the monthly quota. Named plan tiers like the Production Plan imply an upgrade ladder. Missing for 10: documented per-second/hourly rate limits, concurrency caps, explicit self-serve upgrade/plan-change flow, independent corroboration.
